title: One change at a time
statement: Test each change alone against an equally informed control on the same fixed items and conditions, differing only in that change, and adopt it only on a net gain.
detail: An AP training chain kept its settings fixed from version to version under an anti-regression rule that only the data changes. To learn whether a block of curriculum context was needed, it trained two versions side by side that differ only in that block: if the version without it does as well, the block is redundant, and if the one with it does better, the block is doing real work. The control runs on the same fixed items and conditions, the request mix and the writer's examples included.
against: The note records the plan, not the result: both versions were still queued when it was written. most iterations changed nothing, and the loop's proposals sometimes made things slightly worse (a 0.5% regression) and rarely caught code bugs. Gains measured one at a time may not hold together: two prompt changes that each lifted a small paired pilot lowered fresh first-try rates once combined (`icloud-work/aptraining/Cheater/exploits/EXPLOIT-007-difficulty-downgrade.md`, lines 3-6). A changed mix can also expose a real defect: the 90.0% run revealed a genuine conflict between a unit's period and a topic (`icloud-work/ap-social-studies-generator/docs/IMPROVEMENT_PROPOSALS.md`, line 251), so the drop was informative even though it was not a regression. A design fixed before any run; the file records no result. A fix confirmed on one item proves little beyond it: the lab's own takeaways say targeted repair probes prove the fix for that family, not the whole unit, and warn against row-specific hacks masquerading as generalized repairs. A filter that hurt in the bundle can still help alone: question-set checks measured net-negative when bundled recovered about 6 of 40 candidates on their own (icloud-work/aptraining-crystal-copy-20260521/variant-calibration-lab-snapshot/next_live_run_prep.md, line 65).

evidence.quote: Test whether curriculum_context (v52b primary) is necessary, or whether D13 alone (v52 control) suffices. If v52 ≥ v52b → curriculum is redundant. If v52b > v52 → curriculum is doing real work.
